notes.subject: הפליא עצה
notes.rationale: Hifil of פלא: either 'he made the counsel wonderful' (active, YHWH acting) or 'his counsel is wonderful' (KJV/JPS read as adjective); verbs lack explicit subject.

notes.subject: תושיה
notes.rationale: tushiya — rare word, 'sound wisdom/abundance of counsel', found only in poetic wisdom contexts (Job, Proverbs, Isaiah).

translation: Dispela tu i kam aut ⟨long⟩ Yahwe Tsebaot; em i mekim ⟨את⟩ plan i kamap samting i nogut tru, em i mekim olgeta save i kamap bikpela tru.
